method: manual principal-hair-crown/chin and pupil-center estimates on the normalized 1920x1080 grid images; approximate, no automatic face detector or new numeric acceptance tolerance
reference_normalization: A01-v1.png resized from1672x941 to1920x1080 for coordinate comparison only, not a media edit
measurement_uncertainty: manual crown/chin approximately +/-6px each; pupil distance approximately +/-2px. Treat reported 3-5 percent initial size difference as approximate, not pixel-exact ground truth.

local_crop_suggestion_only.preserve_original_ai_mark: Keep crop origin at or before about x20/y20; the original mark starts near x22/y25. Candidate not rendered or validated.
local_crop_suggestion_only.limits: Uniform crop can restore approximate size, cannot prove perfect registration or breathing, and shifts framing slightly right; re-review any derived exact MP4 through the existing owner.
